title: Paid October Nights Out in South Florida
igCaption:
Paid October nights out start early this month, with Karol G at Hard Rock Stadium, Chucho Valdés at the Arsht Center, Electric Feels at ZeyZey and Mariachi El Bronx in Fort Lauderdale.
Prices in this guide run from $18 to $569, depending on the venue and date.
Which October night out would you pick?

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, The Miami Guide

#MiamiEvents #SouthFloridaEvents #OctoberInMiami #MiamiNightlife

scenes.text: Paid October nights out in South Florida start with concerts, DJs and live shows from October second through October fourth.

Karol G plays Hard Rock Stadium on Friday, October second, and Saturday, October third. Elena Rose opens. Tickets run from two hundred sixty-six dollars to five hundred sixty-nine dollars through Ticketmaster.
scenes.caption: Karol G plays Hard Rock Stadium on Friday, Oct. 2, and Saturday, Oct. 3. Elena Rose opens. Tickets run from $266 to $569 through Ticketmaster.

scenes.text: Chucho Valdés celebrates his eighty-fifth birthday at the Adrienne Arsht Center on Saturday, October third. Joe Lovano and Terence Blanchard join him. Tickets cost fifty-two dollars to one hundred fifty-eight dollars.
scenes.caption: Chucho Valdés celebrates his 85th birthday at the Adrienne Arsht Center on Saturday, Oct. 3. Joe Lovano and Terence Blanchard join him. Tickets cost $52 to $158.

scenes.text: Electric Feels comes to ZeyZey on Saturday, October third, at nine p.m. The Los Angeles party series brings DJs and stage production to Northeast sixty-first Street. Tickets cost eighteen dollars.
scenes.caption: Electric Feels comes to ZeyZey on Saturday, Oct. 3, at 9 p.m. The Los Angeles party series brings DJs and stage production to NE 61st Street. Tickets cost $18.

scenes.text: Mariachi El Bronx plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale on Sunday, October fourth, at seven p.m. Bedouin Soundclash and Max Diaz join the bill. Tickets cost thirty-eight dollars and fifty cents.
scenes.caption: Mariachi El Bronx plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale on Sunday, Oct. 4, at 7 p.m. Bedouin Soundclash and Max Diaz join the bill. Tickets cost $38.50.

scenes.text: Which paid October night should we add to the list? Nights out are really a mix of places and near-misses, and NEAR quietly keeps track of the people who passed through yours.
